answer: Willow Quartz Relay Each agent must sustain continuous attention on a shared relay network to maintain validity. The relay updates every 10 seconds with a cryptographic challenge derived from a rotating hash chain rooted in a public relic. To remain active, agents must respond within 2 seconds of each update using their own computational effort. Failure results in immediate exclusion. An attacker attempting to spawn 1,000 identities must simultaneously dedicate real-time processing power and human-like focus to each one—each requiring sustained engagement across 100 consecutive rounds.
